message.content: The case concerns whether lands staff can certify the pump telemetry report for East Pennant irrigation. Claim C, that technicians powered pump P9 on Wednesday, is well supported by the bench activation register (S3) with high confidence. Claim B, that P9 had a 3-inch intake installed on the test bench, is contradicted by the bench register (S1), which specifies a 2-inch intake. Claim A, that P9 reached at least 40 litres per minute on its first test, remains unresolved; while a maintenance engineer’s design curve (S2) suggests 40 litres per minute is plausible, there is no direct evidence confirming this flow was achieved during the initial test. These findings should guide the decision on certification.
